basic_details.job_title: PAU Tractor Operator Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Punjab Agricultural University is filling 1 Tractor Operator post (the notice does not print a number) under PAU Recruitment 2026. The post is on contract at Rs 15414/- per month fixed. Send your application on plain paper to the Director, Raja Harinder Singh Seed Farm, Bir Sikhan Wala, Faridkot, by 28 October 2026. Applications received after the last date will not be considered.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Write your complete application on plain paper. Send it to this address: Director, Raja Harinder Singh Seed Farm, Bir Sikhan Wala, Faridkot.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The Tractor Operator post is filled on contract at Rs 15414/- per month fixed. It falls under the scheme "Facilitating effective functioning at PAU, Misc. 8 (PC-4715)". To be eligible, you need to meet either of these two sets of qualifications: Option 1: Matric with Punjabi; a valid Tractor Driving License; and one year of experience in running and maintenance of Tractor and Agricultural implements. Option 2: Middle with Punjabi; a valid Tractor Driving License; and two years of experience in running and maintenance of Tractor and Agricultural implements. The other rules in the notice are: Age: 18-50 years. Preference: Daily-wage workers who have worked for 10 years in the field at PAU and its outstation stations will get preference. Reservation: 25% and 12% of posts are reserved for candidates belonging to scheduled caste/tribes and backward classes of Punjab state, respectively. 13% of posts are reserved for Ex-Servicemen and 3% for physically handicapped persons.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Attested copies of your certificates A bank draft of Rs 200/- in favour of the Comptroller, PAU, Ludhiana

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The notice says the next steps include a driving skill test and verification of original documents. Dates for these steps and any further information will appear on the PAU official website, www.pau.edu, so check it daily. No TA/DA will be paid for attending.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in PAU Tractor Operator Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 Tractor Operator vacancy. The post is at Raja Harinder Singh Seed Farm, Bir Sikhan Wala, Faridkot.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the PAU Tractor Operator post?
faq.answer: The last date is 28 October 2026. Applications received after the last date will not be considered.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the PAU Tractor Operator post?
faq.answer: You need a valid Tractor Driving License and one of two options. Option 1 is Matric with Punjabi and one year of experience in running and maintenance of Tractor and Agricultural implements. Option 2 is Middle with Punjabi and two years of that experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the PAU Tractor Operator post?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18-50 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of a PAU Tractor Operator?
faq.answer: The pay is Rs 15414/- per month fixed, on contract.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for the PAU Tractor Operator post?
faq.answer: You must send a bank draft of Rs 200/- in favour of the Comptroller, PAU, Ludhiana, with your application.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for the PAU Tractor Operator post?
faq.answer: Write your application on plain paper and send it to the Director, Raja Harinder Singh Seed Farm, Bir Sikhan Wala, Faridkot, by 28 October 2026. Include attested copies of your certificates, the Rs 200/- bank draft, the post name, the advertisement number and date, and your mobile number.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the PAU Tractor Operator post?
faq.answer: The next steps include a driving skill test and verification of original documents. Their dates will be posted on www.pau.edu.

faq.question: Q9. Who gets preference for the PAU Tractor Operator post?
faq.answer: Daily-wage workers who have worked for 10 years in the field at PAU and its outstation stations will get preference.

faq.question: Q10. Will TA/DA be paid for the driving skill test?
faq.answer: No. The notice says no TA/DA will be paid for attending.
